verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents its own registered-agent service, including switching your agent in your incorporation state. It also offers a per-state compliance dashboard where you 'select a state' to expand and 'we'll take care of it,' which implies multi-state agent coverage from one vendor. No evidence explicitly says registered-agent service is available in every US state: the 'all 50 states' claim applies only to payroll, and formation is limited to Delaware and Wyoming. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of registered-agent coverage in all 50 states, confirmation that new-state expansion includes a registered-agent appointment, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state agent service.
